each joint reports a nonzero torque estimate, the IMU snapshot is marked
valid with a fresh receive stamp, and all three IMU vectors carry distinct
nonzero values that the test can read back exactly. The measured position
stays at zero so the initialization target is reached and the recorder's
tracking window is the same as in the static run.
